source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

title: "Off Campus" Co-Stars Test How Well They Know Each Other

lines.en: Can you take me higher?
lines.zh: 你能帶我更上一層樓嗎？

lines.en: My favorite physical touch.
lines.zh: 我最喜歡的肢體接觸。

lines.en: I'll call my mom. I'll call your mom, too.
lines.zh: 我會打給我媽。我也會打給你媽。

lines.en: I love whales.
lines.zh: 我愛鯨魚。

lines.en: Ella: Hi, I'm Ella Bright.
lines.zh: Ella：嗨，我是 Ella Bright。

lines.en: Belmont: And I'm Belmont Cameli. And we are with BuzzFeed to take the co-star test.
lines.zh: Belmont：我是 Belmont Cameli。我們來 BuzzFeed 挑戰合作演員默契測驗。

lines.en: I think we know each other quite well. Very well. Yes.
lines.zh: 我覺得我們滿了解彼此的。非常了解，對。

lines.en: We've spent hundreds and hundreds of hours together.
lines.zh: 我們一起相處了好幾百個小時。

lines.en: And this might be very humbling or great. We'll see.
lines.zh: 這可能會讓我們很汗顏，也可能很棒，看著辦吧。

lines.en: The first time you met each other. Chemistry reads.
lines.zh: 你們第一次見面：對戲試鏡。

lines.en: I was like, "Oh, well, he's obviously completely Garrett Graham, and he's a very cool guy."
lines.zh: 我那時想：「喔，他根本就是 Garrett Graham 本人，而且人很酷。」

lines.en: I thought Ella was super cool. Perfect. Check.
lines.zh: 我覺得 Ella 超酷。完美，答對。

lines.en: The one thing that always makes them break character during a scene.
lines.zh: 總是讓他們在戲裡出戲的一件事。

lines.en: I mean, it's usually me making faces, being unprofessional.
lines.zh: 通常是我在做鬼臉，很不專業。

lines.en: And yours might be Stephen. Yes, 100%. If Stephen's in the room, I'm done.
lines.zh: 你的可能是 Stephen。對，百分之百。只要 Stephen 在場，我就完了。

lines.en: Your favorite rom-com. Love, Rosie. Yes. Nice.
lines.zh: 你最喜歡的愛情喜劇。《真愛繞圈圈》。對，答對了。

lines.en: What's mine? This is going to stress me out. Crazy, Stupid, Love.
lines.zh: 那我的呢？這讓我壓力好大。《熟男型不型》。

lines.en: Question for you guys, since there's hockey here. Have either of you guys watched Heated Rivalry?
lines.zh: 問你們一個問題，既然這部片有冰上曲棍球：你們有人看過《Heated Rivalry》嗎？

lines.en: I haven't had time yet. I've got to see it.
lines.zh: 我還沒空看，一定要去看。

lines.en: It's so good. They're so talented. Watch it in one day.
lines.zh: 超好看，他們好有才華。一天就能看完。

lines.en: The Off Campus co-star that they would make their emergency contact.
lines.zh: 他們會把哪位《Off Campus》演員設為緊急聯絡人。

lines.en: I would say Jaylen, because Jaylen would be like, "Oh, take a Tylenol or something."
lines.zh: 我會說 Jaylen，因為 Jaylen 會說：「喔，吃顆止痛藥之類的吧。」

lines.en: Great advice.
lines.zh: 很棒的建議。

lines.en: Why not each other?
lines.zh: 為什麼不是彼此？

lines.en: We live so far away. I'd need like an 11-hour flight to get to him.
lines.zh: 我們住得太遠了，我要搭 11 個小時的飛機才能到他那裡。

lines.en: There's no emergency that you'd be able to show up in time for, and vice versa.
lines.zh: 不管什麼緊急狀況，你都不可能及時趕到，反過來也一樣。

lines.en: Their go-to karaoke song.
lines.zh: 他們唱卡拉 OK 的必點歌。

lines.en: Actually, "Fast Car" by Tracy Chapman, which I said earlier.
lines.zh: 其實是 Tracy Chapman 的〈Fast Car〉，我剛剛說過。

lines.en: It's "Higher" by Creed. Can you take me higher? Nailed it.
lines.zh: 是 Creed 的〈Higher〉。你能帶我更上一層樓嗎？答對了。

lines.en: How was it filming the karaoke scene in episode three?
lines.zh: 拍第三集的卡拉 OK 那場戲感覺如何？

lines.en: Absolutely terrifying. I've never been more scared for anything in my life. But we had a great time.
lines.zh: 非常可怕，我這輩子沒這麼怕過。但我們玩得很開心。

lines.en: Thank God we pre-recorded a lot of the vocals.
lines.zh: 還好我們很多歌聲都是事先錄好的。

lines.en: So even if I mess up a line or mess up a note, which happened a lot, we have the comfort of having that song already recorded from a few weeks ago.
lines.zh: 所以就算我唱錯詞或走音，而且常常發生，我們還是有幾週前就錄好的版本可以安心。

lines.en: It ended up being a lot of fun, but it was definitely nerve-wracking getting into.
lines.zh: 最後變得很好玩，但一開始真的很讓人緊張。

lines.en: Karaoke was just such a cool vibe to be on set for.
lines.zh: 片場的卡拉 OK 氣氛真的很酷。

lines.en: So glad I didn't have to do karaoke in the show. I had to pole dance, though. So it's kind of pick your battles, you know?
lines.zh: 還好我在劇裡不用唱卡拉 OK，不過我得跳鋼管舞。所以就是各有各的挑戰，你懂吧？

lines.en: Musical artist or band they fan girl over.
lines.zh: 他們會瘋狂追的歌手或樂團。

lines.en: I've been a Remi Wolf fan for years.
lines.zh: 我當 Remi Wolf 的粉絲好多年了。

lines.en: The day on set where Remi Wolf played three songs live, I will never forget. I'll probably tell my kids about it.
lines.zh: Remi Wolf 在片場現場唱了三首歌的那天，我永遠不會忘記，以後大概會講給我的孩子聽。

lines.en: Taylor Swift. It is Taylor Swift.
lines.zh: 泰勒絲。就是泰勒絲。

lines.en: Hannah is obsessed with One Direction.
lines.zh: Hannah 超迷一世代。

lines.en: I was not a Directioner growing up, and then when I got Hannah, I was like, well, I need to do my research.
lines.zh: 我小時候不是一世代的粉絲，但拿到 Hannah 這個角色後，我想說得做功課。

lines.en: And I really enjoyed listening to that music.
lines.zh: 結果我真的很喜歡聽那些歌。

lines.en: I kind of made everybody listen to it during the filming process.
lines.zh: 拍攝期間我還逼大家一起聽。

lines.en: I feel like I know a lot of deep-cut One Direction songs, which I did not know before taking this role.
lines.zh: 我覺得自己現在知道很多一世代的冷門歌，接這個角色前我完全不知道。

lines.en: We need a Harry cameo. That would be insane.
lines.zh: 我們需要 Harry 客串，那會太瘋狂了。

lines.en: Their dating ick or pet peeve.
lines.zh: 他們在約會中倒胃口的點或最受不了的事。

lines.en: Ella Bright's dating ick: immaturity. Grow up.
lines.zh: Ella Bright 的約會地雷：不成熟。長大吧。

lines.en: When they don't get along with your family. That's a great answer.
lines.zh: 對方和你的家人處不來。這是很好的答案。

lines.en: My answer is, like, stage-five clinger.
lines.zh: 我的答案是那種超級黏人的。

lines.en: It was like when they're just a bit too much.
lines.zh: 就是對方有點太過頭的時候。

lines.en: Their love language. Do you think you know mine?
lines.zh: 他們的愛之語。你覺得你知道我的嗎？

lines.en: Most people have two different ones: the way that they give and the way that they receive.
lines.zh: 大多數人有兩種：付出的方式和接收的方式。

lines.en: I give with acts of service, but I prefer physical touch.
lines.zh: 我用服務的行動來付出，但我比較喜歡肢體接觸。

lines.en: I would say words of affirmation is mine, and then physical touch as well.
lines.zh: 我會說我的是肯定的言語，還有肢體接觸。

lines.en: I'm not telling you, BuzzFeed. Use your imagination.
lines.zh: 我才不告訴你呢，BuzzFeed，自己想像吧。

lines.en: Holding hands, though. I love holding hands.
lines.zh: 不過牽手，我很喜歡牽手。

lines.en: I mean, anything nice you can say is always appreciated.
lines.zh: 我是說，任何好聽的話都很受歡迎。

lines.en: A romance trope that they think is the best. Three, two, one. Enemies to lovers.
lines.zh: 他們覺得最棒的浪漫情節套路。三、二、一：由敵人變戀人。

lines.en: There's only one bed scene. That's true. It's one of my favorites from episode two.
lines.zh: 還有「只有一張床」那場戲。沒錯，那是第二集我最喜歡的戲之一。

lines.en: The kinds of posts and videos on their FYP.
lines.zh: 他們「為你推薦」頁面上會出現的貼文和影片。

lines.en: It's literally Chicago sports and orca whales.
lines.zh: 真的就是芝加哥的運動賽事和虎鯨。

lines.en: It's a lot of influencer get-ready-with-me videos. So, I love those.
lines.zh: 很多網紅的「跟我一起準備出門」影片，我很愛看。

lines.en: I used to collect stickers in a book.
lines.zh: 我以前會把貼紙收集在本子裡。

lines.en: Have you guys been seeing all the fan edits?
lines.zh: 你們有看到粉絲做的那些剪輯嗎？

lines.en: My sisters keep sending them to me, so then they become my For You page, and it's really scary.
lines.zh: 我姊妹一直傳給我，結果我的推薦頁面都變成那些，真的很可怕。

lines.en: I don't engage with them on my socials at all, because I don't want to be swiping and see myself.
lines.zh: 我在社群上完全不跟那些互動，因為我不想滑著滑著看到自己。

lines.en: The random topic they could give a PowerPoint presentation about with no prep.
lines.zh: 他們不用準備就能做 PowerPoint 簡報的冷門主題。

lines.en: I can teach you almost everything there is to know about the orca whale.
lines.zh: 關於虎鯨的一切，我幾乎都能教你。

lines.en: So, orca whales are unihemispheric sleepers, which means they sleep with half of their brain at a time.
lines.zh: 虎鯨是單半球睡眠動物，也就是一次只用一半的大腦睡覺。

lines.en: They alternate so that they never completely shut off.
lines.zh: 牠們會輪流交替，所以從來不會完全關機。

lines.en: Orca whales travel in familial pods.
lines.zh: 虎鯨會以家族群體一起移動。

lines.en: In the Pacific Northwest, there are three different subspecies of killer whales: the residents, the transients, and the offshore orcas.
lines.zh: 在太平洋西北地區，有三種不同的虎鯨亞種：定居型、過境型和離岸型。

lines.en: They all speak different languages based on their pods.
lines.zh: 牠們依所屬群體說不同的「語言」。

lines.en: We could do a whole chronology biography on her.
lines.zh: 我們可以幫她做一整套按時間排列的傳記。

lines.en: So instead, I'll say probably beans, because you're from London.
lines.zh: 所以我改說豆子好了，因為你是倫敦人。

lines.en: Love baked beans. On a jacket potato. Very good.
lines.zh: 超愛焗豆。放在帶皮烤馬鈴薯上，很好吃。

lines.en: It's called a jacket potato because it keeps the skin on it.
lines.zh: 它叫「穿夾克的馬鈴薯」，是因為保留了外皮。

lines.en: A celebrity crush. Who do you think mine is?
lines.zh: 喜歡的明星。你覺得我的是誰？

lines.en: You don't have a single celebrity crush? Well, I can't think of it.
lines.zh: 你一個喜歡的明星都沒有？嗯，我想不起來。

lines.en: The go-to snack at craft services.
lines.zh: 他們在劇組點心桌最常吃的零食。

lines.en: There was chia pudding, overnight oats, a lot of the vegetable boxes.
lines.zh: 有奇亞籽布丁、隔夜燕麥，還有很多蔬菜盒。

lines.en: Oh, yeah. All the sandwiches. You'd have like three.
lines.zh: 喔，對，還有三明治，你一次會吃大概三個。

lines.en: It's Red Bull. Yes, it was Red Bull.
lines.zh: 是紅牛。對，就是紅牛。

lines.en: Their favorite scene to film in Off Campus season one.
lines.zh: 他們在《Off Campus》第一季最喜歡拍的戲。

lines.en: Loved filming the hockey scenes. Those days were so fun.
lines.zh: 很愛拍冰上曲棍球的戲，那幾天超好玩。

lines.en: The pop showcase was definitely a big one. I think the karaoke was really fun to bring to life as well.
lines.zh: 流行音樂表演那場絕對是重頭戲，我覺得把卡拉 OK 那場呈現出來也很好玩。

lines.en: Their nickname.
lines.zh: 他們的綽號。

lines.en: A lot of people call me Beef. I love beef.
lines.zh: 很多人叫我「牛肉」，因為我愛吃牛肉。

lines.en: It's got to be an Italian beef sandwich in Chicago with some spicy giardiniera on it.
lines.zh: 一定要是芝加哥的義式牛肉三明治，加上辣味醃菜。

lines.en: I know my beef. I can give a presentation on beef.
lines.zh: 我很懂牛肉，我可以做一場牛肉簡報。

lines.en: The last text I sent you: we just got our billboard up for Off Campus season one in New York.
lines.zh: 我傳給你的最後一則訊息：《Off Campus》第一季的看板在紐約掛上去了。

lines.en: I said, "Good morning," and I sent the picture. It said Times Square.
lines.zh: 我說：「早安」，然後傳了照片，是時代廣場。

lines.en: I don't think I have fun names for any of my contacts.
lines.zh: 我好像沒有幫任何聯絡人取有趣的名字。

lines.en: Their hidden talents.
lines.zh: 他們隱藏的才藝。

lines.en: Rubik's Cube is your hidden talent, but it's not hidden anymore, because people know about this.
lines.zh: 解魔術方塊是你的隱藏才藝，但已經不隱藏了，因為大家都知道了。

lines.en: And you can sing and play multiple instruments.
lines.zh: 你還會唱歌、會好幾種樂器。

lines.en: I wanted to keep that hidden, but I had to do it for the show, and I enjoyed it.
lines.zh: 我本來想藏起來，但因為劇需要只好表演，而且我很享受。

lines.en: Their go-to coffee order. A black coffee for you.
lines.zh: 他們最常點的咖啡。你是黑咖啡。

lines.en: Iced vanilla oat latte. Oat milk cappuccino. Oh, okay. That was close.
lines.zh: 冰香草燕麥拿鐵。燕麥奶卡布奇諾。喔好，很接近了。

lines.en: Their dream actor or director they'd love to work with.
lines.zh: 他們夢想合作的演員或導演。

lines.en: Well, you admire Robert Pattinson. I'd love to work with Robert Pattinson.
lines.zh: 你很欣賞羅伯派汀森。我很想和羅伯派汀森合作。

lines.en: And for you, Greta Gerwig. Yes!
lines.zh: 而你的是葛莉塔潔薇。答對了！

lines.en: The birthday. 28th of February.
lines.zh: 生日。二月二十八日。

lines.en: Relax. It was the previous century.
lines.zh: 放輕鬆，那是上個世紀的事。

lines.en: Yours is November 26th. So close. 27th.
lines.zh: 你的是十一月二十六日。好接近，是二十七日。

lines.en: My entire personality is my lucky number.
lines.zh: 我的整個個性就是我的幸運數字。

lines.en: Their eye color. You have blue eyes.
lines.zh: 他們的眼睛顏色。你是藍眼睛。

lines.en: Little green eyes with a bit of brown in them in the sunlight.
lines.zh: 綠色的眼睛，在陽光下帶一點棕色。

lines.en: Super complex, but you can call it hazel.
lines.zh: 超級複雜，不過你可以叫它淡褐色。

lines.en: 17 out of 21, and he had 15.
lines.zh: 21 題答對 17 題，他答對 15 題。

lines.en: You got more than half the questions right, which means you and your co-star are really friends off-screen.
lines.zh: 你們答對了一半以上，代表你們在戲外也是真正的朋友。

lines.en: While there are still a few questions that tripped you up, you know a little more than the basics when it comes to your co-star.
lines.zh: 雖然還是有幾題讓你們卡住，但你們對合作演員的了解不只是基本而已。

lines.en: That's words of affirmation for me. That's really nice.
lines.zh: 這對我來說就是肯定的言語，真好。

lines.en: I knew more about you than I assumed I would.
lines.zh: 我對你的了解比我以為的還多。

lines.en: But also, it's not surprising, because we talked about literally everything there is to talk about.
lines.zh: 不過這也不意外，因為我們真的什麼都聊過了。

lines.en: Thank you, BuzzFeed. Be sure to watch Off Campus, on Prime Video now.
lines.zh: 謝謝 BuzzFeed。記得在 Prime Video 收看《Off Campus》，現正熱播。
